title: Epic: Apply Vercel React performance best practices
description: Improve Core Web Vitals and runtime efficiency by applying high-impact Vercel React/Next.js rules across the locale app routes and shared components. Success means eliminating avoidable server waterfalls, reducing initial client JS cost for non-critical widgets, and tightening high-frequency client-side render paths without changing UX or i18n behavior.

title: Perf: Cache locale dictionaries per request
description:
## Files
- lib/i18n/dictionaries/get-dictionary.ts (modify)

## What to do
Implement request-scoped dictionary deduplication using React cache so repeated `getDictionary(locale)` calls during the same render pass do not re-run lookup logic across layout/page/metadata. Keep the public API as `getDictionary(locale: Locale): Promise<Dictionary>`. Ensure both `en` and `de` paths are covered and default behavior remains unchanged.

## Don't
- Don't change dictionary content or translation keys
- Don't change call sites in route files for this task
- Don't introduce cross-request mutable global caches
acceptance_criteria: lib/i18n/dictionaries/get-dictionary.ts uses React request cache (or equivalent per-request dedupe) and still exports getDictionary(locale) with the same TypeScript signature; locale routes keep en/de behavior unchanged.
close_reason: 5cdee48 Cache locale dictionaries per request

title: Create robust locale-swap utility in i18n helpers
description:
## Files

## What to do
Add a pure exported helper `swapLocaleInPathname(pathname: string, targetLocale: Locale): string` that safely replaces an existing leading locale segment (`/en` or `/de`) or prepends `targetLocale` when no locale segment exists. Keep behavior deterministic for `/`, nested routes, and trailing slashes. Reuse existing locale validation utilities instead of hardcoding locale strings.

## Don't
- Don't read browser globals (`window`, `document`) in this helper
- Don't modify unrelated locale helper behavior unless required for this function
- Don't add fallback to non-supported locale values
acceptance_criteria:
`lib/i18n/locale.ts` exports `swapLocaleInPathname` with type-safe `Locale` target.
Calling the helper with `/en/rooms/suite` + `de` returns `/de/rooms/suite`.
Calling the helper with `/rooms/suite` + `de` returns `/de/rooms/suite`.
Calling the helper with `/` + `de` returns `/de`.
`npm run lint` passes.

title: Fix: no hreflang alternate links emitted on any locale page (from dekyil-v2-p4w.10)
description: Review of dekyil-v2-p4w.10 found: no locale page emits hreflang alternate links (alternates.languages in Next.js Metadata). Without hreflang, search engines cannot discover the German equivalents of English pages and vice versa, defeating a core SEO goal of the epic. The alternates.canonical field is set per-page, but alternates.languages is absent everywhere. Fix: add alternates.languages to each locale page's generateMetadata, e.g. { 'en': 'https://www.dekyilguesthouse.com/en/<path>', 'de': 'https://www.dekyilguesthouse.com/de/<path>', 'x-default': 'https://www.dekyilguesthouse.com/en/<path>' }. This can be done in a shared helper to avoid repetition.
close_reason: 52a47c1 fix: add hreflang alternate links to all locale pages

title: Fix: locale layout references /scrips/google-tag.js (typo) — should be /scripts/ (from dekyil-v2-p4w.2)

This means Google Tag Manager is silently broken on all locale routes (/en/*, /de/*). The same typo exists in app/layout.tsx (pre-existing), but the locale layout introduced a new copy of the bug. Fix: change '/scrips/google-tag.js' to '/scripts/google-tag.js' in app/[locale]/layout.tsx.
close_reason: ca23035 fix: correct /scrips/ typo to /scripts/ in locale layout

title: Epic: Technical SEO hardening for localized hotel pages
description: This epic exists to fix technical SEO gaps that can suppress indexation and dilute ranking signals on the multilingual Dekyil Guest House site. Success means search engines see one consistent canonical host, locale URLs resolve in a single permanent hop, sitemap/robots/schema output is internally consistent, and key pages expose complete metadata for discovery and rich results. Constraints: preserve existing route structure, keep English and German parity, avoid introducing breaking navigation changes, and keep each child task independently shippable in under one hour.

title: Epic: Add locale-based i18n with German translation
description: Add first-class internationalization to the Next.js App Router site so English and German are both fully supported with localized routes, metadata, and structured data. Success means every customer-facing string is sourced from translation dictionaries, /en and /de routes render equivalent content, and SEO artifacts (sitemap/canonical/alternate links/schema text) are locale-aware. Keep implementation dependency-light and compatible with the current architecture.

title: Set up locale routing and detection middleware
description:
## Files
- middleware.ts (create)
- lib/i18n/config.ts (create)
- lib/i18n/locale.ts (create)

## What to do
Define supported locales as exactly `en` and `de`, with `en` as default. Add middleware that redirects any non-static, non-API route without a locale prefix to `/{defaultLocale}` + original path/query. Preserve already-prefixed routes (`/en/*`, `/de/*`) and skip Next internals/assets (`/_next`, files with extensions, `favicon.ico`, images). Add reusable helpers to parse locale from pathname and to validate locale values.

## Don't
- Don't add third-party i18n packages in this task
- Don't modify page/component copy yet
- Don't hardcode locale logic outside `lib/i18n/*` helpers
acceptance_criteria:
- `middleware.ts` redirects `/` to `/en` and `/rooms` to `/en/rooms` while preserving query params
- Requests to `/de`, `/de/rooms`, and `/en/contact` are not redirected
- Requests to `/_next/*` and static assets are not redirected
- `lib/i18n/config.ts` exposes a typed source of truth for locales used by middleware and future tasks
close_reason: 06357c8 feat: set up locale routing and detection middleware
